bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="$root/.worktrees/bug-report-cfc999ac-20261115"
src=cfc999ac40962b936c6dbe83648d0d2fab421fdd
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$src" || exit 60
test -z "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain)" || exit 61
test -f "$root/deploy/secrets/bug_report_recipient.txt" || exit 62
test ! -L "$root/deploy/secrets/bug_report_recipient.txt" || exit 63
test "$(stat -c '%a' "$root/deploy/secrets/bug_report_recipient.txt")" = 600 || exit 64
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 65
docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bugreport-cfc999ac >/dev/null || exit 66
existing="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$existing" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 67
container="$existing"
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$container")"
service="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.service"}}' "$container")"
config="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}' "$container")"
test "$service" = gaybbs && test -n "$project" && test "$project" != '<no value>' || exit 68
case "$config" in *"$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"*) ;; *) exit 69;; esac
test -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" || exit 70
docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" config --quiet >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 71
old_image_id="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$container")"
docker image tag "$old_image_id" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:prebugreport-20261115 || exit 72
docker image tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bugreport-cfc999ac gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local || exit 73
if ! docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate gaybbs >/tmp/gace-bugreport-deploy.log 2>&1; then
 docker image tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:prebugreport-20261115 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -p "$project" -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 echo BUGREPORT_DEPLOY_REVERTED
 exit 74
fi
sleep 9
new="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' || true)"
if [ "$new" != "$container" ] && [ -z "$new" ]; then exit 75; fi
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$container" 2>/dev/null)" = true || exit 76
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$container")" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bugreport-cfc999ac)" || exit 77
docker logs --since 40s "$container" 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' || exit 78
echo GAYBBS_BUG_REPORT_RUNTIME=READY
echo SOURCE_SHA="$src"
